# The Product Passport Becomes the House Record — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-159172
Voiceover: The ensemble carries material decisions across components; the surviving object cannot narrate every demonstration, correction, and embodied judgment that produced them.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Brooklyn Museum Costume Collection at The Metropolitan Museum of Art; Gift of Edith Gardiner, 1926

Rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access

### 8–16s — CO10-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · REQUIRE — What is legally required now?. Identify product scope, applicable delegated acts, actor, territory, date, required fields, carrier, access rules, and official legal source. Mark future implementation unresolved until adopted.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CO10-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · VERIFY — Who supports each field?. Bind claim, data source, responsible party, verification method, date, confidence, correction, and evidence file. Do not transform a supplier assertion into an audited fact.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CO10-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · EXTEND — What history may responsibly be added?. Connect design development, maker and repair records, care, alterations, provenance, archive deposit, rights, and permitted owner narration while minimizing personal data.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CO10-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · PRESERVE — Will the record survive the vendor?. Require export, open formats, persistent identifiers, versioning, backups, access governance, migration tests, and a non-digital fallback for essential care information.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S08
Voiceover: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Library of Congress

Rights: Link and quote narrowly; check each downloadable resource before redistribution.
